steps.reasoning: All roommate contacts must be collected so transactions involving any roommate can be identified; pagination continues through the first short page.
steps.action_code:
contact_page_limit = 20
roommate_contacts = []
contact_page_index = 0
while True:
    contact_page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, relationship="roommate", page_index=contact_page_index, page_limit=contact_page_limit)
    roommate_contacts.extend(contact_page)
    if len(contact_page) < contact_page_limit:
        break
    contact_page_index += 1
print({"roommate_contact_count": len(roommate_contacts), "roommates": [{"name": " ".join([contact["first_name"], contact["last_name"]]).strip(), "email": contact["email"], "relationships": contact["relationships"]} for contact in roommate_contacts]})
verification_targets: Every page of contacts filtered to the roommate relationship is collected

steps.reasoning: After the like requests, the full feed must be read again and compared with the saved baselines to verify every requested transaction received one additional like.
steps.action_code:
verification_feed = []
verification_page_index = 0
while True:
    verification_page = apis.venmo.show_social_feed(access_token=venmo_access_token, page_index=verification_page_index, page_limit=feed_page_limit)
    verification_feed.extend(verification_page)
    if len(verification_page) < feed_page_limit:
        break
    verification_page_index += 1
verification_by_id = {transaction["transaction_id"]: transaction for transaction in verification_feed}
verification_records = []
for transaction_id in approved_transaction_ids:
    present = transaction_id in verification_by_id
    after_count = verification_by_id[transaction_id]["like_count"] if present else None
    incremented = present and after_count == pre_like_counts[transaction_id] + 1
    verification_records.append({"transaction_id": transaction_id, "present": present, "like_count_before": pre_like_counts[transaction_id], "like_count_after": after_count, "incremented_by_one": incremented})
verification_ok = len(like_results) == len(approved_transaction_ids) and all(record["incremented_by_one"] for record in verification_records)
print({"verified": verification_ok, "transactions": verification_records})
assert verification_ok
